name: io.github.0xSplits/splits-cli
title: Splits
description: Give an AI agent its own key on a dedicated Splits account. At threshold 2+, a human co-signs.

environmentVariables.name: SPLITS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Splits API key (sk_...) from Splits Settings. Optional: leave unset to log in from the agent through the browser-approval tools (auth_login-start, auth_login-status), which save a workspace locally. When set, it takes precedence over saved workspaces.

environmentVariables.name: SPLITS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Alias of the saved workspace to use instead of the active one. Optional; cannot be combined with SPLITS_API_KEY.
